A '''baked pumpkin''' is the simple preparation of the [[pumpkin]]. It heals {{Value|Baked Pumpkin|heals}} and grants {{EffectLink|Resistance}} for {{Value|Baked Pumpkin|duration|effect=Resistance}}.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/oven/baked_pumpkin.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Cooking ===
{{Recipes}}
A pumpkin cooks into a baked pumpkin in an [[oven]] or on [[kindling]] in {{Value|Baked Pumpkin|cook_time}}. Picking up a pumpkin unlocks the recipe.

== Usage ==

=== Food ===
Eating a baked pumpkin takes {{Value|Baked Pumpkin|eat_time}}, heals {{Value|Baked Pumpkin|heals}} and gives Resistance {{Value|Baked Pumpkin|level|effect=Resistance}} for {{Value|Baked Pumpkin|duration|effect=Resistance|format=clock}}.

Obtaining a baked pumpkin unlocks [[Pumpkin Jam|pumpkin jam]] and the [[Pumpkin Empanada|pumpkin empanada]]. It is also used in [[Pumpkin Curry Stock|pumpkin curry stock]].

=== Crafting ingredient ===
{{Uses}}

== Advancements ==
* ''Powerful Flavors'': cook an intrinsic ingredient. Obtaining any of the 11 simple preparations of the ordinary intrinsic ingredients completes it.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/advancement/tutorial/cook_food.json}}</ref>
